sentences.en: When the Mexican military captured and killed the country's top drug lord, it revealed how much President Trump's growing pressure is forcing the country to take on the cartel.
sentences.zh: 当墨西哥军方俘获并击毙该国顶级毒枭时，这揭示了特朗普总统不断施加的压力正逼迫该国有多大程度上打击贩毒集团。

sentences.en: Today, my colleagues Maria Abihabib and Jack Nikas on the operation to take down that drug lord, El Mencho, and whether Mexico has what it takes to win a war
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事玛丽亚·阿比哈比和杰克·尼卡斯将探讨抓捕那个毒枭“埃尔·门乔”的行动，以及墨西哥是否有能力赢得这场战争

sentences.en: on some of the most powerful criminals in the world.
sentences.zh: 针对世界上最强大的罪犯中的一部分人。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, February 26th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月26日，星期四。

sentences.en: Maria, Jack, wonderful to have you both on the show.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚，杰克，很高兴两位来到节目中。

sentences.en: Three Mexico City bureau chiefs.
sentences.zh: 三位墨西哥城分社长。

sentences.en: I'm sitting in your old office, Natalie.
sentences.zh: 我正坐在你以前的办公室里，娜塔莉。

sentences.en: Jack, current, Maria, former, Natalie, former.
sentences.zh: 杰克是现任，玛丽亚是前任，娜塔莉也是前任。

sentences.en: We all were in Latin America as correspondents together.
sentences.zh: 我们都曾在拉丁美洲一起担任过特派记者。

sentences.en: Maria, you and I both covered the cartels at the same time and did some intense reporting on that.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚，你和我当时都在同一时期报道过贩毒集团，并做了一些深入的报道。

sentences.en: To put it lightly.
sentences.zh: 说得轻巧点。

sentences.en: So, we have you here because the news that Mexico had taken out El Mencho, the head of the Jalisco cartel, was massive.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们请你来是因为墨西哥击毙哈利斯科贩毒集团头目埃尔·门乔的消息太震撼了。

sentences.en: And we've learned in the days since that the Trump administration played a big part in that.
sentences.zh: 我们在这之后的几天里了解到，特朗普政府在其中发挥了很大作用。

sentences.en: So, level set for us.
sentences.zh: 那么，给我们理清一下背景。

sentences.en: Why is the takedown of this one cartel leader such a big deal?
sentences.zh: 为什么铲除这个毒枭头目会引起这么大的轰动？

sentences.en: Well, El Mencho was arguably the single biggest criminal in the world.
sentences.zh: 嗯，埃尔·门乔可以说是世界上最庞大的罪犯。

sentences.en: He was arguably the most wanted man in the world.
sentences.zh: 他可以说是世界上头号通缉犯。

sentences.en: He led the biggest cartel in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 他领导着墨西哥最大的贩毒集团。

sentences.en: He led the biggest cartel perhaps in the world.
sentences.zh: 他甚至可能领导着全世界最大的贩毒集团。

sentences.en: And I know we tend to avoid using superlatives, but it's hard to overstate the importance and significance of this figure in the criminal world.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们倾向于避免使用最高级，但这位犯罪世界重要人物的分量无论如何强调都不为过。

sentences.en: And it's a really big deal that the Mexican government went after him because he had been on the run for two decades.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥政府对他穷追不舍是一件大事，因为他已经逃亡了二十年。

sentences.en: He has ties to government figures around the Mexican government.
sentences.zh: 他和墨西哥政府内部的一些人物有联系。

sentences.en: And this is four months just before the World Cup arrives, just a few hours from where he was found.
sentences.zh: 离世界杯开幕还有四个月，就在他被发现的几小时路程之外。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And this is a major move that could open a new chapter of violence in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 这是一个重大的举动，可能会在墨西哥开启新一轮的暴力篇章。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I also think that at this point, this is a huge test for the Mexican government.
sentences.zh: 我也认为在这一点上，这对墨西哥政府来说是一个巨大的考验。

sentences.en: They have never been tested like this.
sentences.zh: 他们从未经历过这样的考验。

sentences.en: And the last time they tried to really take on a domestic threat like this was about 15 years ago, but that was a different cartel, which was not nearly as big,
sentences.zh: 他们上次真正试图应对这种国内威胁大约是在15年前，但那是另一个贩毒集团，规模远没有这么大，

sentences.en: did not nearly have the geographical reach or the penchant for brutality that Jalisco cartel has.
sentences.zh: 地理覆盖范围或残暴成性的程度远不及哈利斯科贩毒集团。

sentences.en: So we're going to be seeing Mexico's security forces tested in a way that we've never seen before.
sentences.zh: 因此我们将看到墨西哥的安全部队经历前所未有的考验。

sentences.en: So let's see what happens.
sentences.zh: 让我们拭目以待吧。

sentences.en: OK, let's talk about El Mencho, this cartel leader.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们来谈谈埃尔·门乔这位贩毒集团头目。

sentences.en: I think for a lot of listeners, he wasn't a household name.
sentences.zh: 我想对很多听众来说，他并不是一个家喻户晓的名字。

sentences.en: So lay out for me how El Mencho got to be the most wanted man in the world.
sentences.zh: 所以请为我梳理一下埃尔·门乔是如何成为世界头号通缉犯的。

sentences.en: Well, he was born into poverty in the state of Michoacan, which is in the WeSt.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他出生在位于西部的米却肯州的一个贫困家庭。

sentences.en: He has five brothers.
sentences.zh: 他有五个兄弟。

sentences.en: He grew up kind of growing avocados, which is one of the livelihoods of Michoacan.
sentences.zh: 他长大后基本上是以种牛油果为生，这是米却肯州的生计之一。

sentences.en: A lot of the avocados that Americans make guacamole from come from that state.
sentences.zh: 美国人做鳄梨酱用的很多牛油果都来自那个州。

sentences.en: He dropped out of primary school, I think about fifth grade, to work in the fields.
sentences.zh: 我想他大概在五年级时就辍学去田里干活了。

sentences.en: And then by the time he was a teenager, he started to guard marijuana plantations, apparently.
sentences.zh: 到了十几岁的时候，他似乎开始看守大麻种植园。

sentences.en: And then he decided that he wanted to immigrate to California.
sentences.zh: 然后他决定移民到加利福尼亚。

sentences.en: So he did so in the 1980s.
sentences.zh: 于是他在上世纪80年代这样做了。

sentences.en: Apparently, he said he wanted a better life.
sentences.zh: 显然，他说他想要更好的生活。

sentences.en: So he moves up to San Francisco, the Bay Area, and he ends up falling back into crime.
sentences.zh: 因此他搬到了旧金山湾区，最后又重操旧业。

sentences.en: And he gets arrested by the police up there.
sentences.zh: 他被那里的警察逮捕了。

sentences.en: He's about 20 at this point.
sentences.zh: 这时的他大约20岁。

sentences.en: And he ends up getting deported.
sentences.zh: 最后他被驱逐出境。

sentences.en: But like the savant that he is, he decides that he's going to start changing names.
sentences.zh: 但就像个天才一样，他决定开始改名换姓。

sentences.en: And he starts crisscrossing the U.S.-Mexico border.
sentences.zh: 他开始频繁往返于美墨边境。

sentences.en: Every time he's arrested, he gets thrown back into Mexico.
sentences.zh: 每次他被捕，都会被遣送回墨西哥。

sentences.en: He comes back.
sentences.zh: 然后他又回来。

sentences.en: By 1992, he's arrested one last time at this point in Sacramento, California.
sentences.zh: 到1992年，他最后一次被捕，这次是在加利福尼亚州萨克拉门托。

sentences.en: And he's arrested because he and his brother are carrying out a heroin deal.
sentences.zh: 他被捕是因为他和兄弟在进行海洛因交易。

sentences.en: And he spends three years in prison.
sentences.zh: 他在监狱里度过了三年。

sentences.en: And so at this point, he's deported again to Mexico.
sentences.zh: 因此这时他再次被驱逐到墨西哥。

sentences.en: And he's in his 30s.
sentences.zh: 他当时三十多岁。

sentences.en: And he joins the local police.
sentences.zh: 然后他加入了当地警方。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Former drug dealer becomes a police officer.
sentences.zh: 前毒贩成了警官。

sentences.en: Kind of a wild career switch.
sentences.zh: 这算是一个疯狂的职业转变。

sentences.en: You know, it happens more than you would think in Mexico because we have to remember that
sentences.zh: 你知道，这在墨西哥比你想象的要多，因为我们必须记住

sentences.en: Mexico has corruption problems specifically within the police.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥存在着腐败问题，特别是在警察内部。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So he becomes a police officer in a police force that is notoriously corrupt.
sentences.zh: 所以他加入了一个以腐败闻名的警察部队，成为了一名警官。

sentences.en: What happens?
sentences.zh: 后来发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, so he kind of realizes that, well, everybody else is on the take.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他意识到，既然其他人都在收黑钱，

sentences.en: And I'd be a sucker not to be on the take.
sentences.zh: 那我不收就是个傻瓜。

sentences.en: So he switches over and he joins the Millennial Cartel, which at this point is very, very strong in the country SouthweSt.
sentences.zh: 于是他转换阵营，加入了千禧年贩毒集团，当时该集团在国家西南部非常非常强大。

sentences.en: And strategically, he realizes the way to really rise up the ranks of this cartel is to marry one of the leader's daughters.
sentences.zh: 从策略上讲，他意识到在这个贩毒集团中真正晋升的途径是娶了其中一位头目的女儿。

sentences.en: So it's a Romeo and Juliet story, but filled with heroin and meth and everything in between.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个罗密欧与朱丽叶的故事，但充满了海洛因、冰毒以及介于两者之间的一切。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: A classic.
sentences.zh: 一个经典的故事。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so he rises through the ranks.
sentences.zh: 于是他在层级中不断晋升。

sentences.en: And then in 2008 and 2009, government security forces end up arresting or killing a bunch of leaders from the Millennial Cartel.
sentences.zh: 然后在2008年和2009年，政府安全部队逮捕或击毙了千禧年贩毒集团的一批头目。

sentences.en: This is in the midst of the last time the Mexican government did a really serious push to dismantle the cartels, a war on these cartels.
sentences.zh: 正值墨西哥政府上次对取缔贩毒集团进行非常严肃的打击、对这些贩毒集团发动战争之际。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it sets off this extremely bloody, brutal leadership fight for who becomes the head honcho of Millennial Cartel.
sentences.zh: 这引发了一场极其血腥、残暴的领导权争夺战，争夺谁来当千禧年贩毒集团的头号老大。

sentences.en: And through sheer brute force and through sheer brute force and his ability to really embrace some of the most disgusting, gruesome, brutal acts,
sentences.zh: 通过纯粹的残酷武力以及他毫不掩饰地拥抱一些最令人作呕、毛骨悚然、残暴行径的能力，

sentences.en: who rises and ends up being on top, well, it's El Mencho.
sentences.zh: 谁最终崛起并登顶了呢？正是埃尔·门乔。

sentences.en: And he spins off his forces to form an independent cartel, which is the Jalisco New Generation Cartel.
sentences.zh: 他分流出自己的势力，组建了一个独立的贩毒集团，即哈利斯科新一代贩毒集团。

sentences.en: Emphasis on generation, because this is a long-term project.
sentences.zh: 重点在于“新一代”，因为这是一个长远的项目。

sentences.en: He's in it for the long haul.
sentences.zh: 他是要长期经营的。

sentences.en: And what is the defining feature of this new group he's leading, the Jalisco Cartel?
sentences.zh: 他领导的这个新团体——哈利斯科贩毒集团的决定性特征是什么？

sentences.en: It's his ability to, or want and desire to really just be as brutal as absolutely possible.
sentences.zh: 是他展现出的能力，或者说意愿和渴望，就是表现得绝对尽可能残忍。

sentences.en: So, for instance, there were reports that his new recruits, he really needed these people to show that they would be as compliant as foot soldiers as they possibly could be,
sentences.zh: 例如，有报道称，他的新招募人员需要向他证明，他们能像步兵一样绝对服从，

sentences.en: and that they were also willing to implement the levels of violence that he himself favored.
sentences.zh: 并且他们也愿意执行他本人青睐的那种暴力程度。

sentences.en: So, for instance, there were reports of cannibalism, you're a recruit, and guess what?
sentences.zh: 例如，有关于食人行为的报道，如果你是一个新兵，你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: You've got to eat somebody, somebody who had betrayed the cartel.
sentences.zh: 你得吃掉某个人，一个背叛了贩毒集团的人。

sentences.en: So, El Mencho becomes a kind of pioneer in this much more aggressive, violent way of doing business.
sentences.zh: 因此，埃尔·门乔成为了这种更具侵略性、更暴力的行事方式的先驱。

sentences.en: And when I was in Mexico, it was also clear that part of his signature was also diversifying the purpose of that violence, right?
sentences.zh: 当我在墨西哥时，也很明显，他的标志之一也是将这种暴力的目的多样化，对吧？

sentences.en: He pursued a broad range of business opportunities that went beyond just drugs.
sentences.zh: 他追求广泛的商业机会，远不止毒品。

sentences.en: Oh, for sure.
sentences.zh: 哦，当然。

sentences.en: He wants the Jalisco Cartel to have a finger in every pie.
sentences.zh: 他希望哈利斯科贩毒集团的手能伸进各个领域。

sentences.en: So, avocados, obviously, something he knows very well from his days picking them when he was a kid.
sentences.zh: 所以牛油果自然不用说，这是他小时候采摘牛油果时非常了解的东西。

sentences.en: Guess what?
sentences.zh: 你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: If you're an avocado grower, you have to either pick avocados for his cartel, or you have to give a piece of whatever you harvest that year to him.
sentences.zh: 如果你是一个牛油果种植者，你要么得为他的贩毒集团采摘牛油果，要么你得把当年收获的一部分交给他。

sentences.en: And then he expands his empire, and it becomes more of like a conglomerate.
sentences.zh: 然后他扩大了他的帝国，它变得更像是一个企业集团。

sentences.en: He's not just doing drugs.
sentences.zh: 他不只在毒品行业。

sentences.en: He's in the hotel industry.
sentences.zh: 他涉足酒店业。

sentences.en: They start bilking, you know, senior citizens from the United States to Canada from their timeshares.
sentences.zh: 他们开始欺诈从美国到加拿大的老年人的分时度假房产。

sentences.en: And also, they're now involved in illegal gold mining throughout South America, which is laying ravage to rainforests across that continent.
sentences.zh: 此外，他们现在还参与了南美洲各地的非法金矿开采，这正在摧毁该大陆的雨林。

sentences.en: I think one visual way to see the different approach of the Jalisco Cartel is the map of Mexico, particularly when it's overlaid with the different cartels' control.
sentences.zh: 我认为直观了解哈利斯科贩毒集团不同方法的一个视觉方式是墨西哥地图，特别是当它与不同贩毒集团的控制范围重叠时。

sentences.en: And what you see is the Jalisco Cartel really has presence across the country, and it really has conquered almost every state it has presence in.
sentences.zh: 你看到的是，哈利斯科贩毒集团确实在全国各地都有存在，而且它确实征服了它有势力存在的几乎每一个州。

sentences.en: And there is widespread corruption within the states and local governments across their region to make sure that Jalisco can do what it wants without any questions.
sentences.zh: 在其控制的地区内，各州和地方政府普遍存在腐败现象，以确保哈利斯科可以毫无阻碍地做它想做的事。

sentences.en: Just talk about that, the extent of the corruption and what this group can do.
sentences.zh: 聊聊这个，腐败的程度以及这个集团能做的事情。

sentences.en: It becomes incredibly powerful, right, and rich.
sentences.zh: 它变得异常强大，对吧，而且很富有。

sentences.en: So that gives them resources to do this kind of work.
sentences.zh: 这为他们提供了开展这种工作的资源。

sentences.en: It gives them resources.
sentences.zh: 它为他们提供了资源。

sentences.en: It's natural for us to make the analogy that these guys are a Fortune 500 company with a diverse set of businesses, no question.
sentences.zh: 我们自然会进行这样的类比：这些家伙是一家拥有多元化业务的财富500强公司，毫无疑问。

sentences.en: They are also, in a way, a state actor.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，他们也是一个国家行为体。

sentences.en: They have their tentacles in the state governments and in the local governments across the country.
sentences.zh: 他们的触角伸向了全国各地的州政府和地方政府。

sentences.en: And that allows them to really operate unbridled.
sentences.zh: 这使他们能够真正无拘无束地运作。

sentences.en: And it even means that when a hurricane hits, sometimes the Jalisco Cartel are the ones providing aid because they want to generate, you know, some goodwill with constituents.
sentences.zh: 这意味着甚至当飓风袭来时，有时提供援助的反而是哈利斯科贩毒集团，因为他们想在选民中建立一些商誉。

sentences.en: So I think it's really difficult to understand the importance of the cartels to the economy, but also to the society.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为很难理解贩毒集团对经济以及对社会的重要性。

sentences.en: They are a fact of daily life in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 他们是墨西哥日常生活中的一个事实。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Given what you've both laid out about the steady and menacing rise of this group and their power across Mexico,
sentences.zh: 鉴于你们两个已经阐述了这个集团稳步而有威胁性的崛起以及他们在墨西哥各地的势力，

sentences.en: I think a lot of people are going to be wondering at this point, what was the government doing this whole time that this was happening?
sentences.zh: 我想很多人此时都会想，在这期间政府都在做什么？

sentences.en: Were they going after the Jalisco Cartel and El Mencho?
sentences.zh: 他们是不是在追捕哈利斯科贩毒集团和埃尔·门乔？

sentences.en: What was their response?
sentences.zh: 他们的回应是什么？

sentences.en: Well, a lot of Mexicans are wondering that as well.
sentences.zh: 嗯，很多墨西哥人也在纳闷这一点。

sentences.en: This certainly was a rise that wasn't just, you know, a single year.
sentences.zh: 这当然不是一朝一夕的崛起。

sentences.en: This is something that played out over 15 or more years.
sentences.zh: 这是历时15年甚至更长时间的过程。

sentences.en: The reality is El Mencho was very elusive.
sentences.zh: 现实是埃尔·门乔非常难以捉摸。

sentences.en: He basically, you know, according to a senior government official I just spoke to, he really basically just used human messengers.
sentences.zh: 基本上，根据我刚刚交谈过的一位高级政府官员所说，他基本上只使用人类信使。

sentences.en: He was not on the phone.
sentences.zh: 他不用电话。

sentences.en: He did not use radio.
sentences.zh: 他不用无线电。

sentences.en: He was extremely disciplined.
sentences.zh: 他极其自律。

sentences.en: And as a result, that allowed him to elude capture for so long.
sentences.zh: 因此，这使他能够逃避抓捕这么长时间。

sentences.en: But it wasn't like they didn't almost catch him a few times.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是说他们没有好几次差点抓住他。

sentences.en: So in 2012, they did go after him.
sentences.zh: 所以在2012年，他们确实去追捕他了。

sentences.en: But his followers, you know, his gunman basically robbed a bunch of cars and they set them on fire and set up these roadblocks across the city.
sentences.zh: 但他的追随者，也就是他的枪手，基本上抢了一堆汽车，放火焚烧，还在全市各处设路障。

sentences.en: And that allowed El Mencho to escape.
sentences.zh: 正是这一点让埃尔·门乔得以逃脱。

sentences.en: In 2015, they also nearly caught El Mencho.
sentences.zh: 2015年，他们也差一点抓到埃尔·门乔。

sentences.en: But his gunman literally shot down a Mexican military helicopter, killing three soldiers.
sentences.zh: 但他的枪手竟然直接击落了一架墨西哥军用直升机，导致三名士兵丧生。

sentences.en: And he got away then as well.
sentences.zh: 当时他也逃掉了。

sentences.en: But over the past decade, there really haven't been many close calls.
sentences.zh: 但在过去十年里，几乎没再发生过几次这么接近成功的情况。

sentences.en: And I think that raises the question of why not.
sentences.zh: 我认为这就带来了一个问题：为什么没有？

sentences.en: I think that is in part because of incompetence by the Mexican authorities, but it is also in part because of complicity.
sentences.zh: 我认为部分原因是墨西哥当局的无能，但部分原因也是因为他们同流合污。

sentences.en: As we noted, this cartel had tentacles in governments across the nation.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所指出的，这个贩毒集团在全国各级政府都有触角。

sentences.en: And that complicates that effort when you've got policemen and politicians tipping them off.
sentences.zh: 当你发现警察和政客都在通风报信时，这就让打击行动变得更加复杂。

sentences.en: Yeah, and it also should be said that a lot of these attempts to kill El Mencho were with the United States.
sentences.zh: 是的，而且还必须说明的是，很多针对埃尔·门乔的暗杀和抓捕尝试都是与美国合作进行的。

sentences.en: Killer capture, really.
sentences.zh: 可以说是一次“击毙或抓获”行动。

sentences.en: And, you know, several American law enforcement had said to me and others on our team that, A, it was very difficult to catch him because he was just that good.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，几位美国执法人员曾向我和我们团队的其他人表示，首先，极难抓到他，因为他实在太狡猾了。

sentences.en: And then, B, there was also this complicity with the Mexican government to an extent where sometimes they were just tipped off and he was able to scurry away.
sentences.zh: 其次，墨西哥政府在某种程度上也与他勾结，有时他们会提前通风报信，让他得以溜之大吉。

sentences.en: So it's both difficult for the Mexican government to fend off the pull of this multibillion-dollar corporation, which is the Jalisco cartel.
sentences.zh: 因此，墨西哥政府既难以抵挡这个价值数十亿美元的庞大企业——哈利斯科贩毒集团的诱惑。

sentences.en: And at the same time, there's been a hesitance or reluctance to go at them head-on because it means going up against a whole system that perpetuates their power.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他们又一直迟疑或不愿正面迎击，因为这意味着要对抗一整套维持其权力的体系。

sentences.en: Right, and I think that's precisely why the cartels have become such an intractable problem for Mexico.
sentences.zh: 没错，我认为这正是贩毒集团成为墨西哥如此棘手难题的原因所在。

sentences.en: And it's what makes it even more shocking that the Mexican government was able to go up against El Mencho this time and actually get him.
sentences.zh: 这也让墨西哥政府这次能够硬刚埃尔·门乔并成功将其抓获，显得更加令人震惊。

sentences.en: So, Jack, walk me through how that operation went down.
sentences.zh: 那么，杰克，给我讲讲那次行动是怎么展开的吧。

sentences.en: So, what we know is that on Sunday morning, Mexican special forces and the Mexican army raided a rental home in a wooded,
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，周日早晨，墨西哥特种部队和墨西哥陆军突袭了一处位于树木繁茂、

sentences.en: picturesque ranch town about two hours south of Guadalajara in Jalisco.
sentences.zh: 风景如画的牧场小镇的出租屋，该镇位于哈利斯科州瓜达拉哈拉以南约两小时车程处。

sentences.en: And they were backed by six military helicopters.
sentences.zh: 他们得到了六架军用直升机的支援。

sentences.en: And they got into a very intense firefight with El Mencho and his men.
sentences.zh: 他们与埃尔·门乔及其手下爆发了极其激烈的枪战。

sentences.en: Mencho slipped out the back and tried to escape with at least two bodyguards.
sentences.zh: 门乔从后门溜出，试图带着至少两名保镖逃跑。

sentences.en: Eventually, Mexican forces then found him hiding in the brush.
sentences.zh: 最终，墨西哥部队发现他藏在灌木丛中。

sentences.en: They continued to engage in crossfire with Mencho and his bodyguards.
sentences.zh: 他们继续与门乔及其保镖交火。

sentences.en: They shot Mencho and his bodyguards.
sentences.zh: 他们击中了门乔和他的保镖。

sentences.en: They were mortally wounded.
sentences.zh: 他们受了致命伤。

sentences.en: They then put El Mencho and his two other bodyguards on a helicopter for air transport to a hospital.
sentences.zh: 随后，他们将埃尔·门乔和另外两名保镖塞进直升机，空运送往医院。

sentences.en: And on the way, we are told, they died.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，他们在途中就死了。

sentences.en: And that was it.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样。

sentences.en: It was certainly bloody.
sentences.zh: 这确实很血腥。

sentences.en: It was certainly violent.
sentences.zh: 也确实很暴力。

sentences.en: But government officials actually told me that it was better than they expected.
sentences.zh: 但政府官员实际上告诉我，情况比他们预期的要好。

sentences.en: And Jack, what do we know about the intelligence that led the operation to be successful in this case?
sentences.zh: 杰克，关于这次行动得以成功的情報，我们知道些什么？

sentences.en: Well, as we noted, El Mencho was an incredibly elusive figure because he was incredibly disciplined.
sentences.zh: 嗯，正如我们所指出的，埃尔·门乔是一个极其难以捉摸的人物，因为他极具纪律性。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: However, it appears that he got a little sloppy.
sentences.zh: 然而，看起来他这次有点大意了。

sentences.en: The Mexican government says that they identified a quote-unquote close associate of a woman who was one of El Mencho's lovers.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥政府表示，他们锁定了一位据称是埃尔·门乔情妇之一的女性的“亲密密友”。

sentences.en: And they watched this man drop this woman off at the home where El Mencho was staying.
sentences.zh: 他们看到这名男子将这名女子送到了埃尔·门乔落脚的住所。

sentences.en: And at that point, they were somehow able to confirm that El Mencho was home.
sentences.zh: 就在那个时候，他们以某种方式确认了埃尔·门乔就在屋里。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太惊人了。

sentences.en: They got him by following his girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 他们是通过跟踪他的女友抓到他的。

sentences.en: Yes, it came down to his lover.
sentences.zh: 是的，线索最终落在了他的情妇身上。

sentences.en: But it also appears that there was important information coming from the CIA.
sentences.zh: 但这也表明，其中似乎有来自中情局的重要情报支持。

sentences.en: There was no American boots on the ground.
sentences.zh: 没有美国地面部队介入。

sentences.en: This was a Mexican law enforcement operation.
sentences.zh: 这是一次墨西哥的执法行动。

sentences.en: But some of the intelligence that fed it came from the United States.
sentences.zh: 但提供支持的部分情报来自美国。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And once El Mencho's death is confirmed, we saw the country erupt in flames as the cartel is responding on the streets.
sentences.zh: 一旦埃尔·门乔的死讯得到证实，我们便看到全国各地烈焰腾空，因为贩毒集团正在街头进行报复。

sentences.en: Cartel members loyal to El Mencho, we understand, were lighting things on fire, blocking roads.
sentences.zh: 据我们了解，忠于埃尔·门乔的贩毒集团成员四处纵火、封锁道路。

sentences.en: We heard of American tourists kind of sheltering in place in their hotels.
sentences.zh: 我们听说美国游客只能躲在各自的酒店里避难。

sentences.en: Just describe what we were seeing in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 请描述一下我们在墨西哥看到的景象。

sentences.en: This was really a day of mayhem.
sentences.zh: 这简直是混乱的一天。

sentences.en: Massive plumes of smoke darken the skies of seaside resort towns and tourist hotspots.
sentences.zh: 滚滚浓烟遮蔽了海滨度假胜地和旅游热门地点上空。

sentences.en: But locals are the most threatened.
sentences.zh: 但当地居民受到的威胁最大。

sentences.en: And it was one of the biggest shows of force and violence by a cartel in recent Mexican history.
sentences.zh: 这是墨西哥近代史上贩毒集团最大规模的武力展示和暴力活动之一。

sentences.en: We were actually terrified.
sentences.zh: 我们当时真的吓坏了。

sentences.en: And we saw the people running down the streets, running from the flames and stuff and the fire.
sentences.zh: 我们看到人们在街头狂奔，逃离火海和那些火焰之类的东西。

sentences.en: And it actually showed the breath of the organization that El Mencho had built because it wasn't just in Jalisco, but it was from coast to coaSt.
sentences.zh: 这实际上展现了埃尔·门乔建立的组织的庞大范围，因为其势力不仅局限于哈利斯科州，而是从海岸到海岸。

sentences.en: In at least 20 states across the nation, there was, you know, cars on fire, blocked roads, banks on fire, supermarkets on fire.
sentences.zh: 在全国至少20个州，你知道的，到处是燃烧的汽车、封锁的道路、被烧毁的银行、被烧毁的超级市场。

sentences.en: And also shootings.
sentences.zh: 还有枪击事件。

sentences.en: You know, there was at least 25 members of the National Guard who were killed as part of some of this mayhem on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在周日的这片混战中，至少有25名国民警卫队成员丧生。

sentences.en: And that was, I think, an explosion of of rage and also power from this Jalisco cartel.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这既是哈利斯科贩毒集团怒火的爆发，也是其权力的爆发。

sentences.en: But it also was a short burst of violence.
sentences.zh: 但这也是一阵短暂的暴力狂潮。

sentences.en: You know, after Sunday, things really have calmed down.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，周日过后，局势确实平静了下来。

sentences.en: And, you know, by midweek, the Mexican government says, you know, all roads are clear.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，到了周中，墨西哥政府表示，所有的道路都已畅通。

sentences.en: All the fires are put out.
sentences.zh: 所有的火灾都已扑灭。

sentences.en: And and there really are no shelter in place orders to speak of.
sentences.zh: 而且基本上没有什么需要执行的居家避难令了。

sentences.en: And so Mexico is kind of back to normal.
sentences.zh: 因此墨西哥某种程度上算是恢复了正常。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And now the question seems to be what happens next?
sentences.zh: 现在的问题似乎是：接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: Does the government decide to keep pushing on an offensive against the Jalisco cartel, given the stakes and the pressure the government is under from the United States,
sentences.zh: 考虑到目前的利害关系以及美国特朗普政府带给墨西哥政府的压力，政府是否决定继续对哈利斯科贩毒集团发动进攻？

sentences.en: from the Trump administration?
sentences.zh: 来自特朗普政府的压力？

sentences.en: That's exactly the question, because while things are back to normal, the country is still very much on edge because Trump is still pressuring the Mexican government to do more.
sentences.zh: 这正是问题所在，因为尽管局势恢复了正常，但全国上下依然处于极度紧张状态，因为特朗普仍在向墨西哥政府施压，要求其采取更多行动。

sentences.en: And you just suddenly have a beheaded cartel that may now be fighting for territory and power.
sentences.zh: 而且你突然拥有了一个群龙无首的贩毒集团，现在可能正为了地盘和权力而内斗。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.zh: 玛丽亚和杰克，

sentences.en: I think one of the biggest questions hanging over all this is just given how long this cartel's power has been steadily expanding and how well known the problem of it has been,
sentences.zh: 我认为笼罩这一切的最大疑问之一是，鉴于这个贩毒集团的势力一直在稳步扩张，且其带来的问题早已众所周知，

sentences.en: why did the Mexican government do this at this moment?
sentences.zh: 为什么墨西哥政府偏偏在这个时候动手？

sentences.en: Why now?
sentences.zh: 为什么是现在？

sentences.en: For one, the Mexican authorities had a piece of very actionable intelligence.
sentences.zh: 一方面，墨西哥当局掌握了一条具有高度可操作性的情报。

sentences.en: And so an opportunity was created and they took advantage of it.
sentences.zh: 因此机会出现了，他们抓住了它。

sentences.en: But this also comes amid the backdrop of a very aggressive offensive against the cartels by President Sheinbaum.
sentences.zh: 但这也是在辛鲍姆总统对贩毒集团展开极其激进的打击背景下发生的。

sentences.en: She basically has made clear that she wants to take a very different tact from her predecessor to go after the cartels.
sentences.zh: 她基本上已经明确表示，她想采取与前任截然不同的策略来打击贩毒集团。

sentences.en: And then there also is one other major difference, and that is Donald J.
sentences.zh: 此外，还有一个主要的重大区别，那就是唐纳德·J·

sentences.en: Trump.
sentences.zh: 特朗普。

sentences.en: What we have in Mexico right now is a sustained pressure campaign from the White House to do more against the cartels.
sentences.zh: 目前我们在墨西哥看到的是白宫持续施压的运动，要求我们在打击贩毒集团方面做得更多。

sentences.en: He does not want any more of the same excuses.
sentences.zh: 他不接受任何同样的借口。

sentences.en: He is saying the Mexican government must solve its cartel problems or the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他说墨西哥政府必须解决其贩毒集团问题，否则美国

sentences.en: military will do it.
sentences.zh: 军方就会动手。

sentences.en: And that has meant repeated and public threats of a unilateral U.S.
sentences.zh: 这意味着美国发出了对贩毒集团进行单边军事打击的反复且公开的威胁，

sentences.zh: 辛鲍姆总统曾表示这是绝不能跨越的红线。

sentences.zh: 因此，我们看到的是墨西哥政府尽其所能地证明自己能够独立处理这个问题。

sentences.en: Right.

sentences.zh: 军队介入并在墨西哥境内发动打击的威胁，在全国以及政府内部是如何被看待的。

sentences.en: Well, you have to remember that California used to be Mexico.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你必须记住，加利福尼亚曾经属于墨西哥。

sentences.en: The history between these two countries has not always been so rosy.
sentences.zh: 这两个国家之间的历史并不总是那么一帆风顺。

sentences.zh: 因此，人们并不怎么渴望美国

sentences.zh: 军队带着地狱火导弹闯进来，试图以此攻击贩毒集团，因为第一，存在主权方面的担忧，第二，

sentences.zh: 存在对附带损害以及可能丧生的平民数量的担忧。

sentences.zh: 因此，

sentences.en: there is a real unease with what Trump is threatening and there also is a real commitment by the Mexican government now to try to show that it can handle the problem itself.
sentences.zh: 对于特朗普的威胁，人们确实感到十分不安，同时墨西哥政府现在也真正坚定了决心，试图证明自己有能力处理这个问题。

sentences.en: And it should be said, this isn't just an idle threat that Trump is making at this point, right?
sentences.zh: 必须指出的是，特朗普此时发出的并非空洞的威胁，对吧？

sentences.zh: 单边行动，那很可能意味着她在该党内部权力的终结。

sentences.en: — So we have this picture of a Mexican president, Claudia Scheinbaum, who's under immense pressure to take action.
sentences.zh: ——所以我们看到这样一幅画面：墨西哥总统克劳迪娅·辛鲍姆正承受着采取行动的巨大压力。

sentences.en: But at the same time, she is someone who, as you've said, has already seemed to be more willing to confront the cartels than other Mexican leaders.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，正如你所说，她似乎比其他墨西哥领导人更愿意正面对抗贩毒集团。

sentences.en: And so I wonder whether it's possible that the pressure from Trump actually may, in a sense, be giving her political cover to do what she may want to do anyway.
sentences.zh: 因此我想知道，特朗普施加的压力是否有可能在某种意义上为她提供政治掩护，让她去做她无论如何都想做的事？

sentences.en: Like, maybe she would have faced some resistance from all these politicians who were in bed with the cartels.
sentences.zh: 比如，也许她本会遭到所有与贩毒集团勾结的政客的阻挠。

sentences.en: Now she can point to Trump and say, look, I have no choice.
sentences.zh: 现在她可以把责任推给特朗普并说，看，我别无选择。

sentences.en: — That is exactly the theory we're hearing from a lot of folks across Mexico who study this, that basically Scheinbaum wanted to go after the cartels.
sentences.zh: ——这正是我们在墨西哥各地研究此事的许多人那里听到的理论，基本上就是辛鲍姆想打击贩毒集团。

sentences.en: But going after the cartels in Mexico with the political structure that exists, with the corruption that exists within the Mexican government from the federal to the local level,
sentences.zh: 但在现有的政治结构下，在从联邦到地方的墨西哥政府内部存在的腐败情况下，打击贩毒集团

sentences.en: is very difficult.
sentences.zh: 非常困难。

sentences.en: But when you have the president of the United States saying, you better do this or we will invade, that changes the calculus.
sentences.zh: 但当美国总统说，你最好这么做，否则我们就入侵时，这就改变了计算方式。

sentences.en: She can go back to her political party and say, I don't have any choice.
sentences.zh: 她可以回过头对她的政党说，我别无选择。

sentences.en: I'm going after El Mencho.
sentences.zh: 我必须去抓埃尔·门乔。

sentences.en: — Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: ——嗯嗯。

sentences.en: — So officials aren't saying outright that this is giving them political cover.
sentences.zh: ——所以官员们并没有直言这为他们提供了政治掩护。

sentences.en: Even off the record, they are saying that they're doing this because it's good for Mexico.
sentences.zh: 即使在非正式场合，他们也表示他们这样做是因为这对墨西哥有利。

sentences.en: But, you know, when those conversations do go deeper and when you speak to more people, there is really an acknowledgment that the Trump effect is real.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，当这些谈话更加深入，当你与更多人交流时，人们确实承认“特朗普效应”是真实存在的。

sentences.en: — Jack, you said that the violence in response to El Mencho's killing died down quite quickly.
sentences.zh: ——杰克，你刚才说，针对杀死埃尔·门乔的报复性暴力活动平息得相当快。

sentences.en: And I want to ask about that because that was actually one of the most surprising things to me, that the violent response from the cartel didn't last longer.
sentences.zh: 我想问一下这一点，因为这实际上让我感到最惊讶的事情之一，就是贩毒集团的暴力反扑没有持续更长时间。

sentences.en: And I wonder if you think it's possible that the cartel moderated their response to their leader's death because they worried that making the country look too out of control might give Donald Trump an excuse to intervene,
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是否认为有这种可能：贩毒集团之所以克制了针对其领袖之死的反应，是因为他们担心把国家搞得过于失控会给唐纳德·特朗普提供干预的借口，

sentences.en: which would be devastating for them.
sentences.zh: 那对他们来说将是毁灭性的。

sentences.en: — Yes.
sentences.zh: ——是的。

sentences.en: So it was surprising that the violence died down that quickly,
sentences.zh: 所以暴力平息得那么快确实令人惊讶，

sentences.en: in large part because we haven't seen it die down like that in other instances of the top leaders getting captured or killed.
sentences.zh: 很大程度上是因为在以往高层领导人被捕或被杀的其他案例中，我们从未见过暴力像这样迅速平息。

sentences.en: — And so I think your theory is certainly a valid one because we have already made clear here that President Sheinbaum is worried about a strike from Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: ——所以我觉得你的理论绝对站得住脚，因为我们之前已经在这里明确指出，辛鲍姆总统很担心遭到唐纳德·特朗普的打击。

sentences.en: Let's be clear, the narcos are also worried.
sentences.zh: 我们要明确一点，毒枭们也很担心。

sentences.en: You know, our colleague Paulina Villegas and I just got back from Sinaloa where we met with multiple narcos and they were very worried.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们的同事保利娜·维勒加斯和我刚从锡那罗亚回来，我们在那里见了几位毒枭，他们非常担忧。

sentences.en: And it also they gave the same reason that the government officials are giving, which is the capture of Maduro changed the game for us.
sentences.zh: 而且他们给出的理由也和政府官员给出的一样，那就是马杜罗的被捕改变了我们的游戏规则。

sentences.en: They now are worried themselves that they may be on the receiving end of a hellfire missile.
sentences.zh: 他们现在自己也开始担心，可能会成为地狱火导弹的攻击目标。

sentences.en: And so that has to be changing the calculus of the criminal organizations in Mexico about how they go about their business,
sentences.zh: 因此，这必然在改变墨西哥犯罪组织对自己行事方式的盘算，

sentences.en: how they carry out revenge like this and how they make a scene, because in some ways they're trying to run a business.
sentences.zh: 他们如何进行这种复仇以及如何大肆炫耀，因为在某种程度上他们是在经营企业。

sentences.en: When you're trying to run a business, you kind of need to keep your head down and sell your drugs.
sentences.zh: 当你试图经营一家企业时，你基本上需要保持低调并贩卖毒品。

sentences.en: — Given that, let's talk about what this capture means for the cartel that El Mencho ran moving forward.
sentences.zh: 鉴于此，我们来谈谈这次抓捕对于埃尔·门乔曾经领导的贩毒集团未来的意义。

sentences.en: What's the upshot for this multibillion-dollar organization?
sentences.zh: 对于这个价值数十亿美元的组织来说，最终结果是什么？

sentences.en: How big of a blow is this for them?
sentences.zh: 这对他们来说是多大的打击？

sentences.en: — Well, it depends on whether or not the commanders who were under El Mencho can agree amongst themselves a clear, clean path to succession.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这取决于埃尔·门乔手下的头目们能否在彼此之间就一条清晰、干净的继承路径达成一致。

sentences.en: Oftentimes the cleanest form of succession is within the family, but Mencho didn't have a lot of kin who could take over.
sentences.zh: 通常最干净的继承方式是在家族内部，但门乔并没有多少可以接班的亲属。

sentences.en: He has four to five commanders who could be his successors.
sentences.zh: 他有四到五个可能成为其继承人的头目。

sentences.en: If they're smart, they'll go ahead and name a successor and agree.
sentences.zh: 如果他们聪明的话，就会直接指定一个继承人并达成一致。

sentences.en: But we rarely see that happen when the head of a cartel is killed.
sentences.zh: 但当一个贩毒集团的头目被杀时，我们很少看到这种情况发生。

sentences.en: So if the cartel cannibalizes itself from within because of this internal leadership, then we could see it fracture.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果该贩毒集团因为内部领导权问题而从内部自相残杀，那么我们可能会看到它分裂。

sentences.en: And when it fractures, that creates many wars all over Mexico.
sentences.zh: 而一旦分裂，就会在整个墨西哥引发多起战争。

sentences.en: — Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That battle over succession could play out across the country for months, if not years.
sentences.zh: 这场关于继承权的争夺可能会在全国范围内持续数月甚至数年。

sentences.en: And I think the question now is, how far is the Mexican government willing to take a war on the cartels?
sentences.zh: 我认为现在的问题是，墨西哥政府愿意把对贩毒集团的打击进行到什么程度？

sentences.en: — Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I think that, you know, American diplomats who have worked here will say,
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道，在这里工作过的美国外交官会说，

sentences.en: when the Mexican government wants to go after these cartels and other criminal organizations, they can do it.
sentences.zh: 当墨西哥政府想要打击这些贩毒集团和其他犯罪组织时，他们是做得到的。

sentences.en: — They are capable.
sentences.zh: 他们是有能力的。

sentences.en: They know how to do it.
sentences.zh: 他们知道该怎么做。

sentences.en: So Mexicans are waiting to see, is this going to be a more sustained battle to dislodge the cartels from all these different corners of Mexico
sentences.zh: 因此，墨西哥人在等待看这是否会是一场更加持久的战斗，以将贩毒集团从墨西哥各个角落清除出去，

sentences.en: and reassert government authority here or not?
sentences.zh: 并在此地重新确立政府权威，还是不会？

sentences.en: But it is a day-to-day battle.
sentences.zh: 但这每天都是一场战斗。

sentences.en: It is not a one-year project.
sentences.zh: 这不是一个一年的项目。

sentences.en: It is a 10-year project.
sentences.zh: 这是一个十年的项目。

sentences.en: Maybe more.
sentences.zh: 也许更久。

sentences.en: — I want to talk about that 10-year project, about what it would actually take to dismantle these groups.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈那个十年的项目，谈谈要瓦解这些组织究竟需要什么。

sentences.en: Because you've both said El Mencho, for example, has plenty of people waiting in the wings to succeed him.
sentences.zh: 因为你们俩都说过，比如埃尔·门乔，身边有很多排着队准备接替他的人。

sentences.en: I mean, we have seen history shows that taking out the boss of a cartel does not automatically eliminate the entire organization underneath him.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们看到历史表明，除掉一个贩毒集团的老大并不能自动消除他手下的整个组织。

sentences.en: — When I was in Sinaloa, I talked to cartel leaders who said, if you take me out, there's 10 more guys waiting to take my place.
sentences.zh: 当我在锡那罗亚时，我跟贩毒集团头目交谈过，他们说，如果你干掉了我，还有十个人排着队准备取代我的位置。

sentences.en: So what is the recipe for long-term success here, for actually, as you said, Maria, dislodging these groups from the country?
sentences.zh: 那么，这里取得长期成功的秘诀是什么，正如你所说，玛丽亚，如何真正将这些集团从这个国家清除出去？

sentences.en: — I think that what we haven't seen from the Mexican government is addressing the corruption.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们还没有看到墨西哥政府着手解决腐败问题。

sentences.en: The reality is, the only way for this criminal group to get this powerful and this big is through the complicity of officials across the nation.
sentences.zh: 现实情况是，这个犯罪集团之所以能变得如此强大和庞大，唯一的原因就是全国各地官员的纵容。

sentences.en: And we haven't seen that level of political will yet from President Sheinbaum and her party to go after the officials
sentences.zh: 而我们还没有从辛鲍姆总统及其政党身上看到那种政治意愿去打击那些官员，

sentences.en: who really actually have already been pointed to as being corrupt.
sentences.zh: 这些官员实际上已经被指控存在腐败问题。

sentences.en: I mean, one of the most powerful senators in Mexico has been directly linked to a cartel.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，墨西哥最有权势的参议员之一已经直接与一个贩毒集团勾结。

sentences.en: The former head of the Navy has been linked to a massive corruption scheme.
sentences.zh: 前海军司令也与一项大规模的腐败计划有关。

sentences.en: And you can go down the liSt.
sentences.zh: 你可以顺着名单一直数下去。

sentences.en: There are many other politicians.
sentences.zh: 还有许多其他政治家。

sentences.en: And this is actually what we hear the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而这实际上正是我们听到的美国

sentences.en: officials really asking for is that is when they will feel there is a sign of real progress
sentences.zh: 官员真正要求的，当他们感到有真正进展的迹象时，

sentences.en: is when the Mexican government starts to go after the corrupt politicians that have enabled this to go on this long.
sentences.zh: 那就是墨西哥政府开始打击那些助长这种情况持续这么久的腐败政客的时候。

sentences.en: Given that this is such an intractable problem, I'm just curious if we know at what point President Trump is going to be satisfied with the progress that Mexico is making.
sentences.zh: 鉴于这是一个如此棘手的问题，我很好奇我们是否知道特朗普总统将在何时对墨西哥取得的进展感到满意。

sentences.en: Like, do we know if this move to take out El Mencho might have appeased Trump and bought the Mexican government some time?
sentences.zh: 比如，我们是否知道这种除掉埃尔·门乔的举动可能会安抚特朗普并为墨西哥政府争取一些时间？

sentences.en: I think Trump's goalposts are infinite.
sentences.zh: 我认为特朗普的目标是无限延伸的。

sentences.en: And the strongest evidence of that is that less than 24 hours after the Mexican government killed El Mencho,
sentences.zh: 最有力的证据就是，在墨西哥政府击毙埃尔·门乔后不到24小时，

sentences.en: probably the single biggest achievement that the government has had in the cartel war in years,
sentences.zh: 这可能是政府近年来在打击贩毒集团战争中取得的唯一最大成就，

sentences.en: Trump posted online, quote, Mexico must step up their efforts on cartel and drugs.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在网上发文称，原话是：墨西哥必须加大对贩毒集团和毒品的打击力度。

sentences.en: And that is, I think, a clear sign that the demands aren't going to end.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这是一个明确的信号，表明这些要求不会结束。

sentences.en: And probably that's the point.
sentences.zh: 也许这就是重点所在。

sentences.en: And possibly that's also what is necessary.
sentences.zh: 可能这也是必要的。

sentences.en: Because there are signs that Trump's pressure is creating a dynamic in Mexico that really hasn't existed before
sentences.zh: 因为有迹象表明，特朗普的压力正在墨西哥催生一种以前从未存在过的动态，

sentences.en: and perhaps is creating the environment that is necessary to finally defeat or at least really confront these massive,
sentences.zh: 也许正在创造必要环境，以最终击败或至少真正对抗这些庞大、

sentences.en: powerful criminal organizations in a way that the government hasn't.
sentences.zh: 强大的犯罪组织，而政府过去并未以这种方式做过。

sentences.en: And I think that there are Mexicans who, while they don't want a unilateral strike from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为有些墨西哥人虽然不希望美国政府发动单方面打击，但确实欢迎特朗普对这件事的关注和对这一问题的施压。

sentences.en: government, do welcome Trump's attention to this matter and pressure on this issue.
sentences.zh: 你是说目标不断移动，这可以被视为一件好事。

sentences.en: You're saying the goalposts moving, that could be seen as a good thing.
sentences.zh: 比如，一方面这是一种诱饵和转换，但在另一方面，这在某种程度上正是进步的运作方式。

sentences.en: Like, in one way, it's a bait and switch, but in another, that's kind of just how progress works.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这可能是件好事，但我认为这取决于它推进到什么程度。

sentences.en: Well, it could be a good thing, but I think it depends on how far it goes.
sentences.zh: 如果特朗普只是持续施压，并且这能够促使并强迫墨西哥政府做它需要做的事来夺回对贩毒集团的控制，

sentences.en: If Trump is just putting consistent pressure on and that is enabling and forcing the Mexican government to do what it needs to do to take control of the cartels,
sentences.zh: 我想许多墨西哥人会同意这是一件极好的事。

sentences.en: I think many Mexicans agree that is a great thing.
sentences.zh: 然而，如果特朗普最终说，你没有按我的要求做，现在我要轰炸你，

sentences.en: However, if Trump ultimately says, you didn't do what I want and now I'm going to bomb you,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为那是完全另外一回事了，因为那将破坏政府稳定，激化局势，并真正把我们抛入未知的境地。

sentences.en: well, I think that's a whole nother story because that is going to destabilize the government, inflame the situation, and really throw us into the unknown.

sentences.zh: 谢谢你，娜塔莉。

sentences.en: Thank you, Natalie.
sentences.zh: 我们在墨西哥想念你。

sentences.en: We miss you here in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我们。

sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。
